title: ilex lonicerifolia var. hakkuensis
intro: Ilex lonicerifolia var. hakkuensis, commonly known as Hakku holly, is a plant species in the Ilex genus, native to certain regions in Korea. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation and fever, due to its health benefits in reducing oxidative stress and promoting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Ilex lonicerifolia var. hakkuensis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with diseases such as arthritis and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its potential therapeutic applications.
